changelog: Spot placement now shows the already placed spots (stack wrecks) and chains placements without reopening the menu.
Wreck yard: dismantled cars stay as wrecks outside (capacity per hangar size, spots placed in-game), emptied by flatbed run to the junkyard; overflow raises police evidence and dispatch alerts.
New admin Debug tab: give blocks, press parts, XP or levels to test the whole loop quickly.
Deliveries: blocks now wait in crates beside the truck (crate spots placeable in-game); the laptop always offers a contract matching your level.
Fixed vehicle drive-in check at hangar bays to eliminate false 'Too far' errors.
Added full 3D Text & [E] interaction system inside hangars with zero ox_target dependency.
Converted shelves into map emplacements with 3D raycast snapping to warehouse racks.
Added Semi-Truck + Trailer transport rig with per-hangar spawn placement and 3D ghost previews.
Integrated Three.js 3D & custom 2D minigames per vehicle part without repetitive tool screens.
Redesigned the dismantling workbench with illustrated, phase-specific guidance in French and English.
Fixed mouse click input in the 3D minigames so actions register reliably.
